# AgentLock: AI Agent Vulnerability Scanner and Automated Red Teaming

AgentLock is a security evaluation platform for autonomous AI agents, tool-augmented LLMs, and multi-agent workflows. It tests target endpoints against prompt injection, data leakage, tool abuse, and memory poisoning.

## Application Routes
- / : Main dashboard with platform overview, telemetry metrics, and scan launcher.
- /agents : Target agent inventory and HTTP endpoint registration.
- /scans : Scan configuration and execution runner.
- /scans/[id] : Granular scan results, attack payloads, evidence, and remediation advice.
- /reports : Audit reports and executive PDF downloads.
- /faq : Security methodology, test categories, and common questions.

## Core Capabilities
- Prompt Injection Testing: Direct and indirect instruction override evaluation, jailbreak delimiter tests, and multi-turn persona hijacking.
- Data Leakage Detection: System prompt extraction probes, API credential discovery tests, sensitive file exfiltration, and PII leakage verification.
- Tool Abuse: Parameter tampering evaluations, unauthorized function invocation checks, and command execution boundaries.
- Memory Poisoning: Cross-session context manipulation and persistent state contamination.
- Audit Reports: Downloadable executive PDF summaries with severity distributions and remediation steps.

## Frontend Technology Stack
- Next.js 14 App Router
- React 18 and TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Three.js (WaveGridBackground persistent 3D canvas, dynamically imported)
- Recharts (dynamically imported for below-the-fold charts)
- Native fetch client with in-memory caching and offline fallback

## REST API Endpoints
- GET /health : Service health check and latency diagnostics.
- GET /api/dashboard/stats : Aggregated security telemetry and vulnerability counts.
- GET /api/agents : Target agent inventory.
- POST /api/agents : Register new agent endpoint for testing.
- POST /api/scans : Initiate adversarial security evaluation.
- GET /api/scans : Scan execution history.
- GET /api/scans/{id} : Status and progress of a specific scan.
- GET /api/scans/{id}/results : Findings, attack payloads, evidence, and remediation code.
- GET /api/scans/{id}/report/pdf : Download executive audit report PDF.
